styleguide.title: Styleguide
styleguide.intro: Tokens and components of the design system for the guest pages. Development only.
styleguide.motionHint: Off when the device asks for reduced motion: then everything is visible right away. The switch simulates this for the whole page.
styleguide.motionMedium: Closing, changes of step and panels
styleguide.motionSlow: Sheets and dialogs, with a spring
styleguide.motionLong: Fading in on scroll, the check and its particles
styleguide.motionEasing: Ease-out for almost everything, a soft spring for what opens
styleguide.motionReveal: Rises in once with a short offset upwards when it scrolls into view. In the first screen it is visible right away.
styleguide.motionStagger: The children fade in one after another, 40 ms apart. A chosen time gets a short pulse in the accent colour.
styleguide.motionPress: Buttons and chips give way when pressed. Photo cards lift under the pointer, the photo zooms in its frame.
styleguide.motionParallax: Once loaded, it slowly zooms to its size once. While scrolling it moves slower than the content and gets darker.
styleguide.motionSlide: A new step slides in from the side: forward from the right, back from the left.
styleguide.motionSuccess: The circle pops in with a spring, the check draws itself, small particles fly out once. The card slides up.
styleguide.motionPanels: Skeletons shimmer softly. Dialogs open with a spring.
styleguide.focusHint: Press Tab: everything that can be operated shows a ring of 2 px at a distance of 2 px.
